what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. Paths are repo-relative.
name: Lion President
summary: A new mid-flank crease and upper shoulder roll replace the broad flat side; raised arch cuts sample the original section at their actual height. Reshaped cabin stations, lower rear belt and independently annotated pane boundaries correct the high, forward glass. Window overlays clip to actual substrate triangles. The fascia bends through four broad close-view planes, with graphics sharing that transform. LOD0 wheels gain a shallow dish, lip and broader spokes. Coarse wing endplates remain explicit thin planes with crossed supports; coarse spokes are symmetric. Rear-glass foot stations follow deck height at their own x/z, including the bowed centre, closing the visible foot gap. Original colliders, hinges, anchors and handling are preserved. Exported triangles: 2296 / 900 / 592 against 2400 / 900 / 600 budgets. Weighted silhouette overlap regresses at every tier. LOD0 top IoU falls from 0.9365 to 0.9244, while side improves from 0.9467 to 0.9524. LOD1 side/rear and LOD2 side also regress. The LOD1 side-glass gate passes narrowly, 0.5066 against 0.5000. Coarse wing planes, tyre proportions and high spoiler retain the stylised reference interpretation.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

specTwin.sharedSpec: One spec, two bodies (R123): the Hawk Dash and the Lion President name spec 'aussie-v8' in web/shared/src/roster.json, and their profiles' handling (tuning) is identical, held by tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs. Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

reference.note: Unchanged generated reference sheets. Each comparison shows reference, revised render and silhouette diff through frozen shared perspective cameras (50m front/rear, 10m side/top, horizontal optical axis). Before/after and local reference contours/lamp envelopes are recorded in validation.md. Generated views are not calibrated photographs; measured regressions are disclosed.
